title: Offer 1-click consented install of tracked external design tools in /hivemind:design-pack (super-design out-of-box)
description:
Goal (human directive 2026-07-23): when a consumer wants 'super design' (a design-heavy project), the framework should let them get the tracked external design tools (Impeccable, Taste Skill, Higgsfield MCP, 21st.dev Magic MCP — registered in packs/design-power/descriptor.json by TASK-178) 'out of the box' via an OFFER + single explicit consent, installed from UPSTREAM (auto-updating, NOT vendored/assimilated), with the human gate preserved. Chosen mechanism (of 4 options): 'Offer + 1-click consent on setup', NOT silent auto-install and NOT assimilation.

Home: the existing consumer-facing command commands/design-pack.md (/hivemind:design-pack). Today its Step 5 splits results into (1) skills materialized, (2) skills needing assimilation → points to assimilate-current-project, (3) Wave-2 mcp/plugin → PRINTS the install command for the human to run. This ticket adds: for the tracked/installable design tools, OFFER to run the upstream installer on the human's explicit yes, instead of only printing it.

Important interaction with prior decisions: the four TASK-178 resources are INERT in the reconciler (kind:plugin/mcp, no resourceActivations key) — deliberately, human-accepted. So they do NOT appear in resolve/reconcile-plan/report. The offer must therefore read them directly from packs/design-power/descriptor.json resources[] (data-driven), NOT rely on the reconciler surfacing them. Keep the automatic reconciler inert; the OFFER lives only in the deliberate, human-invoked /design-pack command.

Design (data-driven classification from descriptor resources[], NO schema change — infer from existing fields):
- install contains 'assimilate' (e.g. ui-ux-pro-max) → UNCHANGED: route to the human-gated assimilate-current-project skill. Never auto-run.
- kind:plugin installable skills (Impeccable install '/plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable' or 'npx impeccable install'; Taste 'npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill') → OFFER to run on explicit consent. For Taste, DEFAULT the offer to the focused skill via `npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill design-taste-frontend` (a bare add pulls the WHOLE 13-skill collection — do not dump 13 skills on every consumer by default; mention the full collection is available if they want it).
- kind:mcp needing auth/billing (Higgsfield 'claude mcp add --transport http --scope user higgsfield https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp' → OAuth + PAID credits; 21st.dev 'npx @21st-dev/cli@latest install claude --api-key <key>' → API key) → OFFER to run the registration step, but CLEARLY disclose the auth + billing before consent, and note the consumer must complete OAuth / provide the key themselves. Never hide the cost.

SECURITY INVARIANT (must be explicit + preserved): running any third-party installer requires an explicit, per-invocation human consent that names exactly what will run and its trust/billing implications. This offer is NEVER autonomous and is NEVER liftable by any loop_auth grant (mirror the assimilation carve-out). A consumer must be able to decline per-tool. Global-vs-project install scope must be stated (Impeccable/Taste install globally into ~/.claude, affecting all the consumer's projects).

Also: keep Step 5's three existing lists working; add the offer as an extension, not a replacement. Update the command description + the orchestrator-routing 'Addon-pack + assimilate surface' pointer if needed. commands/ ships to consumers — verify this stays a consumer entry point and does not run in the framework repo itself.

verification_tier tests-after: this is primarily command prose driving the orchestrator; if any classification/consent helper is added in src/, tdd-lock the consent-gate (never-autonomous, decline-per-tool) with a spec. Full review required (consumer-facing + executes third-party installers + supply-chain posture). Run test:all if any bundled src/dist changes; otherwise npm test + the command/doc sensors.
acceptance_criteria: /hivemind:design-pack (commands/design-pack.md) offers to install the tracked external design tools read directly from packs/design-power/descriptor.json resources[] (Impeccable, Taste, Higgsfield, 21st.dev), independent of the reconciler (which stays inert for them)

Each install runs ONLY after an explicit per-invocation human consent that names the exact command, the install scope (global ~/.claude for skills), and any auth/billing (Higgsfield OAuth+credits, 21st.dev API key); the human can decline per-tool

The offer is documented as NEVER autonomous and NEVER liftable by any loop_auth grant (mirrors the assimilation carve-out); assimilate-routed resources (ui-ux-pro-max) still route to the human-gated assimilate-current-project and are never auto-run
Taste Skill's offer defaults to the focused `--skill design-taste-frontend` (not the bare add that installs all 13 skills); the fuller collection is mentioned as opt-in
MCP tools (Higgsfield, 21st.dev) disclose auth + billing before consent and note the consumer completes OAuth / supplies the key; registration is offered, not silently performed

Step 5's existing three lists (materialized / needs-assimilation / Wave-2-print) still function; the offer is additive; command remains a consumer entry point (guarded against running in the framework repo)

If any src/ helper is added it is tdd-tested for the consent gate (never-autonomous, per-tool decline) and dist rebuilt; npm test green (test:all if bundled src/dist changed); reviewer confirms the security/consent invariant is preserved

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT (verified by Orchestrator — read the final commands/design-pack.md Step 6 at b283a22 against each AC; the offer/consent flow is human-observable command behavior, verified by walking the documented steps). Steps (expected → observed → verdict):
1. Offers tracked tools read directly from descriptor, independent of the reconciler → Step 6/6a filters descriptor resources[] by the marker substring, explicitly notes the four are inert in resolve/reconcile-plan and must be read straight from the descriptor → PASS
2. Explicit per-invocation consent naming exact command + scope + auth/billing; per-tool declinable → 6c/6d state the exact command, GLOBAL ~/.claude scope (skills) / user vs project (mcps), and Higgsfield OAuth+paid / 21st.dev key+free-tier BEFORE asking; 6c/6d ask per-tool [y/N], decline on one never skips another → PASS
3. Never autonomous; never loop_auth-liftable (incl. /hivemind:loop); assimilate resources route to human-gated skill, never auto-run → 6e states it verbatim; 6b rule 1 routes any 'assimilate' install to assimilate-current-project first, never auto-run → PASS
4. Taste defaults to focused --skill design-taste-frontend; full 13-skill collection opt-in only → 6c → PASS
5. MCPs disclose auth+billing before consent; consumer completes auth; registration offered not silently performed; never fabricate a credential → 6d → PASS
6. Step 5's three lists still function; offer is additive; consumer entry point guard intact → Step 6 declared 'independent of Steps 2-4 and additive'; Steps 1-5 textually unchanged → PASS
7. TUI-vs-shell correctness (from review fix): offer-to-run only auto-execs commands the orchestrator can run (npx, claude mcp add); TUI-only /plugin installs are guided; Impeccable offers npx impeccable install → 6b general rule + 6c → PASS; marker coupling locked by tests/design-power-descriptor.spec.js AC6 (red-green proven)
Overall: PASS. Pure prose + one regression spec; npm test 73 files / 1001 passed / 2 skipped (green). No src/dist touched.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
DONE (tests-after). Added Step 6 to the consumer-facing /hivemind:design-pack command: on a design-heavy project it OFFERS to install the four tracked external design tools (Impeccable, Taste Skill, Higgsfield, 21st.dev Magic) from upstream on explicit per-tool human consent, read directly from packs/design-power/descriptor.json (the reconciler stays inert for them). Two commits: 8c529fd (Step 6 + orchestrator-routing pointer, byte-identical parity copies) + b283a22 (review fixes). Pure prose + one regression spec; no src/dist touched; npm test 1001 passed/2 skipped.

Review: APPROVE at review_depth=FULL (consumer-facing surface that drives third-party installers behind a consent gate). 0 HIGH; 3 MEDIUM; 2 LOW. Reviewer independently confirmed the two security-critical points: (1) the 6a marker filter targets EXACTLY the four tracked resources and no others (assimilate-routed ui-ux-pro-max + older Wave-2 frontend-design/shadcn/etc. excluded), fail-safe direction; (2) the consent gate is explicit, per-tool declinable, never autonomous, never liftable by any loop_auth grant including inside /hivemind:loop. All three MEDIUMs fixed in b283a22: (a) Impeccable's offer now uses the shell-executable `npx impeccable install` with a general TUI-vs-shell rule (only auto-run commands the orchestrator can exec; /plugin TUI installs are guided, never silently failed on a 'yes'); (b) added a red-green-proven regression lock (design-power-descriptor.spec.js AC6) so a future descriptor reword of the 'not gated by resourceActivations' marker fails loudly instead of silently emptying the offer; (c) wording fix (resourceActivations is a src/design-profile.js map, not a descriptor key). The reviewer's R3-checklist MEDIUM was a visibility artifact — the developer hand-off did carry the 5-item checklist (all done/n-a). LOW #2 (UAT gate) satisfied by the uat comment below.

UAT: PASS (orchestrator-verified against the final command prose; see uat comment) — all 7 ACs covered.

Model note for consumers: this is how someone who wants 'super design' gets these third-party skills out of the box — offered + consented, upstream/auto-updating, never vendored, never silently run. Delivers the human's directive while preserving the assimilation-grade human gate. Review APPROVE (not RC) and 0 HIGH; the MEDIUM fix loop was orchestrator-initiated polish, not a reviewer REQUEST-CHANGES — no knowledge draft mandated per TASK-105.
